scope: All 16 bundled application modules and their generated whole-module audit were freshly compiled and individually kernel-replayed. All application constants, including private and generated constants, were audited. Exactly 913 required native objects were reused after pinned source/object/import and dependency-fingerprint authentication before and after. Pinned Mathlib/Lean caches were reused; this is not a fresh rebuild of the entire upstream closure. No periodic-census or cylinder-energy objects are used.
